title: HTTP for testers: methods, status codes and headers

videos.script: Most defects in an app are not on the screen. They are one layer down, in the answers the server gives. {{layers}} This course tests that layer first, and then the app on a phone. In this lesson you set up your own machine and start a small API called boxoffice. It sells tickets for a theatre in São Paulo. {{boxoffice}} You will talk to it with curl and read every line it answers. {{curl}} A request has a method, an address, some headers and sometimes a body. The answer has a status code, its own headers and a body. {{anatomy}} Then the three parts a tester reads first. The method says what the client wants done. The status code says what happened, in three digits. The headers say how to read the rest. {{parts}} You will also find the first defect in boxoffice. It refuses a method every web server is required to answer. {{defect}} By the end you can ask an API a question and tell whether its answer is right.
